technology_name: A NATURAL FIBER REINFORCED POLYMER COMPOSITE FOR ORTHODONTIC APPLICATIONS AND METHOD OF PREPARING THE SAME
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Standard orthodontic brackets and retainers made from metals or ceramics can cause mouth irritation, leach metallic ions, or lack structural custom elasticity.
description: A structural natural fiber-reinforced poly(methyl methacrylate) (PMMA) composite formulated by processing organic fibers extracted from the banana plant to supply exceptional specific strength and stiffness bounds.
applications: Biocompatible dental bracket manufacturing, custom orthodontic retainer wiring, dental orthopedic splints, and structural prosthetic reinforcement frames.
